description: Pixel-perfect LOGIN screen (Figma node 47:3798): rebuild login/page.tsx content and LoginForm markup inside the shell from FEAT-001, composing the Input/Button/Label atoms + PasswordToggle molecule + Email/Password icons. Reuse the existing LoginForm logic (RHF + createLoginSchema + useLogin + field names email/password/rememberMe + submit handler) unchanged — only the markup is restructured. Depends on FEAT-001 (shell, tokens, i18n keys).
steps: Read context.json, this file, and the Login section of figma-auth.md. Optionally re-run get_design_context on 47:3798 for exact values (already captured during planning: card gap-12 sections; heading block gap-3 items-center text-center; title Paragraph lg Semibold 20/32 #18181b -> text-foreground; subtitle Paragraph xsm 14/20 #52525a -> text-text-body; fields block flex-col gap-6 w-full; each field flex-col gap-3; label Paragraph sm Medium 16/24 with red '*' #ef4444 -> text-destructive; Input md, radius 8, placeholder #a1a1aa Paragraph xsm; email trailing EmailIcon; password leading eye toggle + trailing PasswordIcon; forgot link Paragraph xsm Medium underlined #14b8a6 -> text-secondary, full width end-aligned; submit Button primary md full width radius 12 'تسجيل الدخول'; footer centered: 'ليس لديك حساب؟ ' #18181b + 'سجل الآن' secondary underlined link to register).

Edit src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/page.tsx: remove the Card/CardHeader/CardContent/CardTitle/CardDescription imports and usage. Keep generateMetadata and setRequestLocale. Render inside the shell card: (from @/components/icons), a heading block (div flex flex-col gap-3 items-center text-center) with the title (t('loginHeading'), class text-foreground text-[20px] leading-8 font-semibold) and subtitle (t('loginSubheading'), text-text-body text-sm leading-5), then , then a centered footer

with t('registerFooterPrefix') in text-foreground and a secondary underlined Link (from @/lib/i18n/navigation) to routes.register with t('registerFooterCta') in text-secondary underline.

Edit src/features/auth/components/login-form.tsx: keep 'use client', useForm with zodResolver(createLoginSchema(tv)), useLogin(), defaultValues and field names unchanged, and the onSubmit handler calling login.mutate(values). Restructure the markup to: a fields wrapper div (flex flex-col gap-6 w-full); email field (flex flex-col gap-3): a Label (htmlFor='email', with a trailing red '*' span text-destructive, end-aligned) + Input md type=email endIcon={} placeholder={t('emailPlaceholder')} + error

text-destructive text-sm; password field (flex flex-col gap-3): Label 'كلمة السر' + required '*', a relative wrapper with Input md type={pw.type} startIcon via the eye toggle and endIcon={} placeholder={t('passwordPlaceholder')} using usePasswordToggle() — place the PasswordToggle button absolute inset-y-0 start-0 pointer-events-auto per the molecule's documented pattern; error

; then the secondary underlined forgot-password Link (text-secondary text-sm underline, full width text-end) to routes.forgotPassword with t('forgotPasswordLink'). Keep the rememberMe checkbox wired (may be visually minimal, but field stays registered). Submit: full-width primary Button (size md, w-full) with the spinner-while-pending pattern and t('loginCta'). Use logical properties only.
Pixel compare: run the figma power get_screenshot on node 47:3798 and compare against the built /ar/login. Adjust spacing/sizes/colors/radii/typography until there is no visible 1px drift.
acceptance_criteria: login/page.tsx no longer uses the Card component and renders logo + heading + LoginForm + footer inside the shell.
LoginForm keeps the same schema, field names (email/password/rememberMe), useLogin mutation, and submit contract; only markup changed.
Login visually matches node 47:3798 (layout, spacing, colors, radii, typography) with no visible 1px drift in get_screenshot comparison, in both RTL and light/dark.
verification: From repo root: npm run typegen ; npm run typecheck ; npm run lint ; npm run test ; npm run build — all pass with 0 errors.
get_screenshot on 47:3798 compared to the built login page shows a pixel match.
findings:
Implemented pixel-perfect Login (node 47:3798). login/page.tsx: dropped the Card/CardHeader/CardContent/CardTitle/CardDescription imports+usage; kept generateMetadata + setRequestLocale; renders LogoMark size=144, a centered heading block (gap-3) with title (text-[20px] leading-8 font-semibold text-foreground) + subtitle (text-sm leading-5 text-text-body), then , then a centered footer

with registerFooterPrefix (text-foreground) + a text-secondary underline Link to routes.register (registerFooterCta). LoginForm: schema/field-names (email/password/rememberMe)/useLogin/zodResolver(createLoginSchema(tv))/onSubmit(login.mutate) unchanged; only markup restructured to a w-full flex-col gap-6 wrapper with two flex-col gap-3 fields. All i18n keys (loginHeading/loginSubheading/emailLabel/emailPlaceholder/passwordLabel/passwordPlaceholder/forgotPasswordLink/registerFooterPrefix/registerFooterCta) already existed from FEAT-001 in both ar/en. RTL icon mapping corrected against the real Figma RTL screenshot: label text sits at the start (right in RTL) with the red '*' span rendered to its left (DOM order = text then '*'), so Label uses default justify + w-full (not justify-end). Email envelope and Password lock icons are on the right (start) -> passed as startIcon; the eye PasswordToggle is on the left (end) -> absolute inset-y-0 end-0 pointer-events-auto over a relative wrapper, with an empty size-4 endIcon reserving pe padding. Forgot-password Link is text-start (right in RTL). rememberMe stays registered but sr-only (not shown in the Figma card). Submit is a full-width size=md primary Button with the Loader2Icon spinner-while-pending. Verification (repo root, all green): npm run typegen OK; npm run typecheck OK (0 errors); npm run lint OK (0 errors); npm run test OK (37 files / 145 tests, schemas.test.ts 7/7 unchanged); npm run build OK. Pixel compare: captured the built /ar/login (prod server + Playwright at 1440x1024) in RTL light and dark vs get_screenshot(47:3798) and iterated to no visible 1px drift on the card internals (logo, heading, fields, icons, labels, forgot link, submit, footer). git status shows only login/page.tsx + login-form.tsx modified; AGENTS.md nextjs-agent-rules block unchanged (no next dev regeneration). Out-of-scope note for the shell step (FEAT-001): the Figma frame places the auth card on the right and the hero image on the left, but the shell layout.tsx renders DOM order , which in RTL puts the card on the left. Card internals match 47:3798 exactly; the left/right column swap is owned by the FEAT-001 shell, not this feature, and was left untouched.
